text:
emily_support: Heads-up — inbound quota uplift request from ClipperAI (ticket #CL-4219). They reported a product launch tomorrow and asked for a temporary rate increase. Posting the support intake here for triage. https://tickets.internal/CL-4219

jake_sales: FYI they are on a paid pilot but no contractual commit beyond pilot. want to support the launch if low risk. Customer says traffic spike for 48h only.

emily_support: Requested numbers: currently 60 r/s, asking for 300 r/s for 48h. Customer-provided usage spike example + sample api keys: key ending ...9f3a.

auto-bot: auto-threshold-checker: anomaly_score=0.92, pattern=high_concurrency_from_multiple_ips, recent_failed_auth=3, fraud_flag_recommendation=manual_review_required :eyes:

marta_fraud: @emily_support thanks — can you drop request headers + IP list and any billing mismatch? Also need CL-4219 history. If we see credential stuffing or rapid key rotation, we hold.

emily_support: Paste of sanitized logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z POST /v1/generate key=***9f3a ip=52.14.23.11 tokens=1024 model=redwood-medium status=200
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z POST /v1/generate key=***9f3a ip=18.212.7.9  tokens=998  model=redwood-medium status=200
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z POST /v1/generate key=***4f1b ip=52.14.23.11 tokens=1100 model=redwood-medium status=200
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z POST /v1/generate key=***9f3a ip=3.120.44.5  tokens=1050 model=redwood-medium status=200
```
Full log export attached to ticket.

jake_sales: Customer contact is Hannah (hannah@clipper.ai). She's offered to sign an LOA and provide billing verification within 1 hour. Sales is ready to fast-track if fraud ops ok. :thumbsup:

marta_fraud: Quick notes from initial scan: multiple keys used from same subnets, high concurrency, tokens per request consistent with bulk generation. No clear payment red flags yet but identity not verified. I recommend phone verification + card on file before full uplift. If they can provide LOA + billing confirm we can consider a limited temporary uplift.

alex_product: For product constraints: we can offer a conditional uplift workflow — options: (A) Temporary permissive uplift to 150 r/s for 48h with tight monitoring and auto-revoke on anomalous metrics; (B) Full 300 r/s for 24h after LOA + fraud clear; (C) No uplift until fraud sign-off. Need ✅ from security/fraud and engineering on rollback controls. What are the launch criteria here?

nate_enginfra: We can implement a per-key override via admin console in ~15 min and set hard cap at 350 r/s global. Also can add a model fallback policy (route to smaller model under pressure) and a throttled 429 policy for bursts above allowed. Recommend metrics alert: error rate spike >2% or token spend >2x baseline triggers auto-revoke.

emily_support: Proposed immediate action: 1) Put request on hold pending fraud ops phone check (marta) OR 2) grant conservative uplift: 2x current (120 r/s) for 24h with monitoring. Which should we take?

marta_fraud: I'll run phone verification and fraud-score enrichment now. Tentative approval path: LOA + billing verify -> allow 150-200 r/s for 48h with monitoring; if anything anomalous, revoke immediately. If LOA not provided within 1 hour, fallback to conservative 120 r/s for 24h. I'll update CL-4219 in ~2h.

jake_sales: Sales can secure LOA within 30m and confirm card. If that's true, go with option B (300 r/s for 24h) conditional on monitoring and auto-revoke.

alex_product: If we give 300 r/s, product wants clear rollback plan + canary: stage uplift to a small % of keys first (e.g., 10%) then ramp to all of their keys after 30 min if metrics OK. Also require rate-limit headers and quota quotas visible in UI for customer.

emily_support: I'll hold until @marta_fraud updates. If fraud ops clears and sales confirms LOA, we'll spin up per-key override and apply canary. For audit: record approval in ticket and tag with approvers (marta, alex, nate).

marta_fraud: Update: phone verification complete, billing card last4=4242, LOA draft sent by sales. Fraud scoring now 0.21 after enrichment. I'll clear for 150 r/s immediate, escalate to 300 r/s only after LOA signed and 30-min canary.

jake_sales: Signing inbound — pushing LOA to Hannah now.

emily_support: Action items captured in CL-4219: 1) fraud ops clearance (marta) 2) LOA signed (sales) 3) eng infra per-key override + canary rollout (nate) 4) product sign-off on rollback criteria (alex). I'll patch ticket and schedule a 30m watch window once uplift is applied.

alex_product: Agreed. Add metric guardrails: CPU>70% on serving nodes OR latency p95 > 600ms -> auto-revoke. Also require RBAC log entry for the override.

nate_enginfra: I'll prep the admin override and alert runbook. If we hit auto-revoke, we route to redwood-small and send incident ping to #eng-oncall and #support.

emily_support: Thanks team. Holding in pending state until LOA signed + final fraud ok. Will update thread when we apply any uplift. :white_check_mark:

marta_fraud: Closing note: if we see token sizes >2k consistently or new key churn, immediate block.

emily_support: noted. closing loop here for now.
